min_zhang: Heads-up — onboarding atlas-16b-int4 to dedicated pool and hitting intermittent OOMs when max_new_tokens >= 1024. Happens mostly on qa-dedicated (gpu-pool-3), ~1/100 requests. Noticed spike after long prefix.
infra-bot: ALERT: OOM on gpu-pool-3 (node gpux-17) for tenant:redwood-qa. logs: /var/logs/oom/gpux-17/1805009987.log
sophia_k: can you paste the model serving config? fragmentation vs single huge alloc? :thinking:
min_zhang: config snippet:
```
model: atlas-16b-int4
batch_size: 8
max_new_tokens: 1024
prefetch_kv: true
kv_trim_policy: auto
quant: int4
```
david_p: first triage: lower defaults — max_new_tokens -> 512, batch_size -> 4, disable prefetch_kv. prefetch often increases peak working set for long prefixes. also try forcing kv_eviction to be more aggressive.
min_zhang: tried disable prefetch + batch_size=4. frequency dropped to ~1/400 but still see hard OOMs. sample log:
```
[2026-03-18T14:33:12Z] cudaError: out of memory
alloc failed: requested 312MB, available 256MB (largest free 128MB)
heap stats: total 16000MB, used 14200MB, free 1800MB, frag_ratio=0.47
```
olivia_s: frag_ratio ~0.47 points to fragmentation, not just absolute. quick mitigation: periodic compaction after request boundary and smaller default max_new_tokens for int4 variants. env flags to try: REDWOOD_PREFETCH_KV=false, REDWOOD_KV_EAGER_EVICT=true, REDWOOD_MEM_COMPACT_INTERVAL=60
sophia_k: can you run a memdump + trace to confirm allocation patterns? use: `rw-infer trace --model atlas-16b-int4 --memdump /tmp/atlas-mem.json --runs 5` and upload.
min_zhang: ran trace (attached small summary): frag_ratio avg=0.42, worst=0.51. compaction reduces peak ~6% but heavy prefixes still hit the pathological case. plan: 1) set default max_new_tokens=512 for atlas-16b-int4 in model catalog 2) enable kv_eager_evict for dedicated pools 3) add canary rollout that monitors oom_rate and p95 latency and falls back to atlas-16b-8bit if OOM rate > 0.5% during 10m window.
david_p: +1 to canary and fallback. add alert for oom_rate > 0.2% so we can auto-scale or fallback sooner. also ensure perf test with long-prefix distribution (docs/bench/long_prefix.yaml).
min_zhang: will open PR for model-catalog defaults + canary config. scheduling canary for next maintenance window. thanks all. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: canary deploy queued: atlas-16b-int4-defaults-canary -> eng-dedicated-pool-3 at 2026-03-19T02:00:00Z (link: https://deploys.redwood.io/canary/1805010440)
sophia_k: Nice. after canary we should run evals against the regression suite (prompt sets: convo-long, code-gen-long) to ensure quality unchanged with reduced max_new_tokens.
min_zhang: noted — will include eval run and post results.
